verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party evidence that monday.com automations can be versioned, reviewed as change history, or rolled back. The nearest items are adjacent features that do not transfer to this story: 'promote versions' applies to developer apps scaffolded via the developer MCP, and the agent audit log covers agent actions rather than automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
